'''O'rqe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] specialist who was stationed on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]]. He was an armstech specialist.<ref name="Encounter">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|Hidden Imperial Base|Manaan}}</ref>
